text: "The counterparty supplies the **statement** and closes the contract terms." (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md, §3.2) ⏎ - For a `hash` lock: `statement = sha256(preimage)` — the payee mints the preimage (`generateHashLock()`) and sends the hash statement. ⏎ - For a `point` lock: `statement = Y` — the payee mints `(y, Y)` (`generatePointLock()`) and sends the point statement. ⏎ - Format: `0x` + 64 lowercase hex (32 bytes) for hash statements; `0x` + 66 lowercase hex (33-byte SEC1-compressed secp256k1, on-curve) for point statements. ⏎ - `statement` is a required field of the `accept` frame and is bound into the contract id: `contract` = `0x` + sha256 of `FLOP::tclk::v1|contract|<canonical {offer, accept-core}>`, which commits to `ref`, `from`, `statement`, `paymentKey`, `nonce`.
